question: A certain number of men can do a piece of work in 48 days. If there were 30 more men, it would take 18 days less to complete the work. The number of men, initially, is:
solution:
**Given:**

Number of days taken by certain men to complete a work = 48 days

Number of men increased by 30, Then number of days taken by men to complete a work is 30 days. (i.e. 48 - 18)

**Concept Used:**

Inverse proportion

When two things are related inversely to each other. i.e. increase in one thing leads to decrease in other. For example, there is number of days( required to complete the work. If we increase the number of man then required days to complete the work is less.
